messages:
julia: Heads up — OrionCloud confirmed APAC edge region (ap-southeast-4) go/no-go on Thu. We need marketplace SKU entitlements + KMS access + Dedicated quota approval by EOD Wed. Can ops/partnerships own the gate?
raj: I can own quota/tickets. Do we have SKU list and expected qps/capacity? :eyes: 
julia: SKU list attached (see below). Target initial capacity: 6xA100-equivalent nodes, 50k qps burst, steady 6k qps. Partner wants marketplace listing day-1.
emma: Legal (lia) needs the MSA addendum signed for marketplace resale. Lia — can you scope timeline?
lia: I can turn around the addendum draft in 24–36h if product terms are locked. Need to confirm data residency + KMS customer-managed key flow.
hiro (OrionCloud): confirming Orion will provide KMS integration via CloudKMS+BYOK; SLA for key ops is okay. We need Redwood's public KMS endpoint and the IAM roles.
julia: Great. Raj — ops will need the SKU codes we plan to publish. Here's the quick list:
```
SKUs:
 - orion.apac.edge.small
 - orion.apac.edge.medium
 - orion.apac.edge.dedicated-6xA100
```
Please open marketplace entitlement ticket and tag @deploy-bot.
raj: Opening ticket now — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ORION-APAC-123
deploy-bot: created ticket ORION-APAC-123 assigned to raj; due 2026-04-01
emma: Lia + legal: can you confirm export control review? Also prod needs the network peering template.
lia: export control: ok but need final vendor certs. Pinged vendor for HW certs.
julia: Ops, can you validate capacity with Dedicated team? If we can't guarantee Dedicated nodes, fallback plan is Shared-hosted with quotas.
raj: Pinged dedicated infra: @dai from dedicated says "we can reserve 4 nodes now, but need final PO for 6".
hiro (OrionCloud): We can accept phased listing: host marketplace listing with shared first, then promote to dedicated after PO.
julia: Timeline check — Plan A: Legal signoff + entitlement approval by Wed EOD -> marketplace soft-publish Thu -> Dedicated capacity live Tue next week.
emma: I'll schedule a quick 15m sync with Orion & ops tomorrow 09:30 PT. Calendar invite sent.
lia: Noted. I'll work on addendum and export docs. If vendor certs don't arrive by Tue noon, we delay publish.
raj: Ticket ORION-APAC-123 updated with capacity numbers + KMS request. Tagging @dai @emma @lia.
hiro (OrionCloud): Adding our SRE contact @mike-orion to thread — he'll coordinate load tests.
mike-orion: added, starting validation run Wed 03:00 UTC — will post results.
julia: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits blockers call out in this thread. :thumbsup:
